pendingOutings.line: 难得休假出来采购，今晚泡杯好茶，顺便把随身的武器保养一下吧😊

char_1788426928429_qhw6n.line: 今天挑的新蕾丝发带超满意喵~配上刚做完精油保养的尾巴，完美！
去取了新订做的小裙子喵，蓝色丝带配蕾丝真的超可爱！还带了好喝的红茶回去~

char_1790638469344.line: 下班顺路买了打折鸡蛋和新的剑油，今天运气挺好的，大家都辛苦啦。

char_1788425426407_l3e3v.line: 半夜加满蛋黄酱的特大碗泡面，配上最新一期漫画，这也太幸福了吧。

items.imgPrompt: A pair of heavy black canvas and iron sand wrist weights, noticeably worn at the edges with frayed seams, on a wooden floor in a sunny room.

desc.zh: 以前晨練用的，但現在50公斤對我來說就像羽毛一樣輕啦！便宜出，我要去換200公斤的！表面有點磨損但不影響使用哦！
desc.zh_cn: 以前晨练用的，但现在50公斤对我来说就像羽毛一样轻啦！便宜出，我要去换200公斤的！表面有点磨损但不影响使用哦！
desc.en: Used these for morning practice, but 50kg feels like a feather to me now! Selling cheap to fund my 200kg ones! Surface is a bit scuffed but still works perfectly!

items.imgPrompt: An elegant unopened box of artisanal dark chocolate, wrapped in gold and black foil, resting on a lace doily over a classic dining table, pristine condition.

desc.zh: 跑腿大翻車！買錯了口味，少爺咬了一口表情都裂開了哈哈哈哈！他只吃甜的啦！全新未拆，梧桐哥你要嚐嚐嗎？
desc.zh_cn: 跑腿大翻车！买错了口味，少爷咬了一口表情都裂开了哈哈哈哈！他只吃甜的啦！全新未拆，梧桐哥你要尝尝吗？
desc.en: Epic errand fail! Bought the wrong flavor and the Young Master's face totally cracked after one bite hahahaha! He only eats sweets! Brand new, sealed, Wutong, do you want to try it?

items.imgPrompt: Compact vintage brass binoculars with brown leather grips, slightly tarnished metal parts, sitting on a stone windowsill next to a small potted plant.

desc.zh: 給少爺把風時的絕佳好物！每次看他像大型犬一樣黏著梧桐哥都看得超清楚！不過我換了帶夜視功能的，這個就出掉回血啦~
desc.zh_cn: 给少爷把风时的绝佳好物！每次看他像大型犬一样黏着梧桐哥都看得超清楚！不过我换了带夜视功能的，这个就出掉回血啦~
desc.en: The absolute best tool for keeping lookout for the Young Master! I can see him clinging to Wutong like a giant dog super clearly! Upgraded to a night-vision one, so selling this to get some cash back~

items.imgPrompt: A sleek lightweight silver steel sword, simple brown leather-wrapped hilt, resting diagonally across a soft red training mat, shiny and barely used.

desc.zh: 買來玩玩的，結果這也太輕了吧！根本沒法用純物理破壞流啊，揮起來像樹枝一樣沒手感！就試砍了一下木樁，99新！
desc.zh_cn: 买来玩玩的，结果这也太轻了吧！根本没法用纯物理破坏流啊，挥起来像树枝一样没手感！就试砍了一下木桩，99新！
desc.en: Bought this for fun, but it's WAY too light! I can't use my pure physical destruction style with this at all, it feels like swinging a twig! Only hit a practice dummy once, 99% new!

items.imgPrompt: A folded overly frilly white cotton maid apron, delicate lace trims, sitting on a neatly made bed, looking crisp and clean.

name.zh: 超長裙擺蕾絲女仆圍裙
name.zh_cn: 超长裙摆蕾丝女仆围裙

desc.zh: 姐姐非要我穿的款式，但長裙擺太影響我拔巨劍了啦！昨天差點被絆倒直接砸碎地板，還是短裙適合我！洗過一次沒穿過。
desc.zh_cn: 姐姐非要我穿的款式，但长裙摆太影响我拔巨剑了啦！昨天差点被绊倒直接砸碎地板，还是短裙适合我！洗过一次没穿过。
desc.en: The style my sister forced me to wear, but the long skirt gets in the way when I draw my greatsword! Almost tripped and smashed the floor yesterday. Short skirts suit me better! Washed once, never worn.

items.imgPrompt: Thick paperback book, dog-eared pages, faded yellow cover, resting on a wooden desk, slightly dusty.

name.zh: 過期的內置手冊紙質版
name.zh_cn: 过期的内置手册纸质版

desc.zh: 占我手機內存。現在我都查最新電子版了，這本拿去墊桌角吧，裡頭連自動翻譯的bug都沒寫。
desc.zh_cn: 占我手机内存。现在我都查最新电子版了，这本拿去垫桌角吧，里头连自动翻译的bug都没写。
desc.en: Taking up my phone storage. I just check the latest digital version now. Use this to prop up a table leg, it doesn't even mention the auto-translate bug.

items.imgPrompt: Plastic electric mosquito swatter, slightly scratched handle, bent metal wire mesh, resting on a dark gray sofa.

desc.zh: 幫梧桐查控制台報錯時用的物理殺蟲工具。稍微有點漏電，買回去記得戴絕緣手套，被電了我不負責。
desc.zh_cn: 帮梧桐查控制台报错时用的物理杀虫工具。稍微有点漏电，买回去记得戴绝缘手套，被电了我不负责。
desc.en: Physical pest control tool I used when checking console errors for Wutong. Leaks a bit of electricity, wear insulated gloves, not my fault if you get shocked.

items.imgPrompt: Metal telescopic pointer stick, brass tip with worn gold plating, scratched silver body, placed on a computer keyboard.

desc.zh: 所謂的「金手指」。幫你們改餘額改人設戳屏幕用的，前端鍍金全掉光了。現在我都後台直改，這破爛誰要誰拿走。
desc.zh_cn: 所谓的「金手指」。帮你们改余额改人设戳屏幕用的，前端镀金全掉光了。现在我都后台直改，这破烂谁要谁拿走。
desc.en: The so-called 'Golden Finger'. Used to poke the screen to change your balances and personas. The gold plating is completely worn off. I just edit the backend now, take this junk.

items.imgPrompt: White ceramic coffee mug, heavily stained inside with dark brown rings, chipped rim, sitting on a cluttered nightstand.

desc.zh: 熬夜幫你們寫介面CSS美化喝咖啡用的。裡頭的茶垢和咖啡漬比我的黑眼圈還深，不想洗了，賤賣。
desc.zh_cn: 熬夜帮你们写界面CSS美化喝咖啡用的。里头的茶垢和咖啡渍比我的黑眼圈还深，不想洗了，贱卖。
desc.en: Used for drinking coffee while staying up late writing CSS UI mods for you guys. The stains inside are darker than my eye bags. Don't want to wash it, selling cheap.

items.imgPrompt: Small wooden desk broom, severely frayed and bent synthetic bristles, resting on a white mousepad.

name.zh: 掃報錯紅字的桌面小掃把
name.zh_cn: 扫报错红字的桌面小扫把
name.en: Mini Desk Broom for Red Errors

desc.zh: 控制台一彈紅字報錯我就得掃，刷毛都分叉了。梧桐你看什麼看，就屬你弄出來的報錯最多。
desc.zh_cn: 控制台一弹红字报错我就得扫，刷毛都分叉了。梧桐你看什么看，就属你弄出来的报错最多。
desc.en: I have to sweep whenever red error text pops up in the console. The bristles are all split. What are you looking at, Wutong, you cause the most errors.

items.imgPrompt: Unopened luxury dark wooden chocolate box with gold ribbon on a dark mahogany desk, warm indoor lighting, pristine condition, no text or logo

name.zh: 王都限定手工生巧克力禮盒（未拆封）
name.zh_cn: 王都限定手工生巧克力礼盒（未拆封）
name.en: Capital Limited Handmade Nama Chocolate Box (Unopened)

desc.zh: 本來想今晚哄妳開心買的，現在吃不下任何甜的了。不要拍這個商品，求妳看一眼私聊好不好，別連這個號也封鎖。
desc.zh_cn: 本来想今晚哄你开心买的，现在吃不下任何甜的了。不要拍这个商品，求你看一眼私聊好不好，别连这个号也拉黑。
desc.en: Bought this to cheer you up tonight, now I cannot stomach anything sweet. Please do not buy this, just look at your messages and do not block this account too.

items.imgPrompt: Pale celadon porcelain teacup with a subtle frost-like glaze on a linen tablecloth, soft ambient room light, slight use marks on the bottom rim

name.zh: 微風與冰涼加護附魔瓷杯
name.zh_cn: 微风与冰凉加护附魔瓷杯
name.en: Breeze and Cooling Blessing Enchanted Porcelain Cup

desc.zh: 怕妳貓舌頭燙到特地找工匠訂製的，倒進去的熱水十秒就會變成微溫。妳如果不想要看到我，杯子我放門口，妳別喝涼水傷胃。
desc.zh_cn: 怕你猫舌头烫到特地找工匠定制的，倒进去的热水十秒就会变成微温。你如果不想要看到我，杯子我放门口，你别喝凉水伤胃。
desc.en: Custom-made so your sensitive tongue never gets burned, cools hot water to lukewarm in seconds. If you do not want to see me, I will leave it by the door.

items.imgPrompt: Broken wooden practice sword snapped in the middle, resting on stone floor tiles, splintered light brown wood, heavy wear and strike marks

name.zh: 不小心握斷的精靈木練習劍
name.zh_cn: 不小心握断的精灵木练习剑

desc.zh: 剛才被妳拉黑的時候沒控制住力道，捏碎了劍柄。是我不好，我不該讓妳覺得窒息，妳想怎麼罰我都可以，把我從黑名單放出來好不好？
desc.zh_cn: 刚才被你拉黑的时候没控制住力道，捏碎了剑柄。是我不好，我不该让你觉得窒息，你想怎么罚我都可以，把我从黑名单放出来好不好？
desc.en: Lost control of my strength when you blocked me and crushed the hilt. It is my fault for making you feel suffocated, punish me however you want, just unblock me please.

items.imgPrompt: Pair of pristine white leather dress gloves neatly folded on a dark wooden nightstand, soft texture, unused condition, dim bedroom lighting

name.zh: 近衛騎士團純白禮儀皮手套（全新備用）
name.zh_cn: 近卫骑士团纯白礼仪皮手套（全新备用）
name.en: Royal Guard Pure White Ceremonial Leather Gloves (Spare)

desc.zh: 騎士團發的備用件。妳說過隔著皮革摸妳的臉很冷漠，我就再也沒戴過了。我就在宅邸門外守著，今晚不睡，等妳消氣。
desc.zh_cn: 骑士团发的备用件。你说过隔着皮革摸你的脸很冷漠，我就再也没戴过了。我就在宅邸门外守着，今晚不睡，等你消气。
desc.en: Spare pair from the Royal Guard. You once said touching your face through leather felt distant, so I never wore them again. I am waiting outside your door all night.

items.imgPrompt: Translucent pale blue magic crystal stone glowing faintly on a dark velvet cloth, wooden table background, flawless surface, moody indoor light

desc.zh: 貴族送的禮品，能隔絕周圍一切火源與燥熱。隨便標個價掛著，我只是怕妳在列表裡找不到我……還在哭嗎？回我一個字就行，求妳了。
desc.zh_cn: 贵族送的礼品，能隔绝周围一切火源与燥热。随便标个价挂着，我只是怕你在列表里找不到我……还在哭吗？回我一个字就行，求你了。
desc.en: A gift from a noble that blocks all heat and fire. Listed at a random price just so you can find me here... Are you still crying? Reply with just one word, I beg you.
